title: skills: the objectui project-setup guide still sends a third-party app to @object-ui/providers for uploads, a package PR #30550 retires
body:
domain:ui#1 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgWn6zhNa4LL7VB1rtL

Filing gate: ① (a governed guide that will teach an import that no longer resolves; named producer below). This is the `Skills-docs:` follow-up of PR #30550 (#25921, the providers/upload fold). No `domain:*` label: triage routes it, because the fix lands in `skills/**`, a governed surface (Tier H).

## Observed

On `origin/main`, `skills/objectui/guides/project-setup.md` says in two places that uploads come from `@object-ui/providers`:

- line 249, the provider-stack list: "`UploadProvider` / `useUpload` (`@object-ui/providers`) — the upload adapter the file and image fields upload through."
- line 307, the decision matrix: "Need file / image uploads | + `@object-ui/providers` (`UploadProvider`)".

PR #30550 retires `@object-ui/providers`. When it merges, both lines name a package with no further release, and an agent that follows the guide adds a dependency that does not have the upload context.

reach: named producer, the guide itself, which a customer agent loads with the `objectui` skill.

## Wanted

The two lines name where each piece lives after PR #30550:

- `UploadProvider` / `useUpload` come from `@object-ui/fields`.
- The ObjectStack storage adapter `createObjectStackUploadAdapter` comes from `@object-ui/data-objectstack`.
- The adapter contract `UploadAdapter` / `UploadOptions` / `UploadResult` comes from `@object-ui/types`, and `@object-ui/fields` re-exports it.

Nothing else in the guide changes.

## Order

Start after PR #30550 merges. Until then the guide is still true on `main`.

Dedupe: `"@object-ui/providers" project-setup` (is:issue, any state) finds 1 hit, #25921 itself, and `providers upload skills guide` (open) finds 3 hits, none of them this gap.
